name: Improved Shadow Magic (Wayang)
body:
Shadow magic comes more naturally to you than others of your race.

Prerequisite: Wayang, Shadow Magic racial trait, Charisma 13

Benefit: You may use shape shadows as a spell-like ability at will, and add silent image and darkness to the spell-like abilities that you may use once each per day. Your caster level is equal to your character level.
